title: SSV Silver Gull — Ship Combat
description: Ship-combat systems for the SSV Silver Gull campaign. Full-screen Ship Overview (press S) with a crew-centric multiplayer turn/action tracker and per-station action consoles for all 15 stations. Shields/Comms is fully built (Allocate Shields, Jam/Hail rolls, green Micro-Adjust); the Captain's Grant Actions gives a crew a purple-star extra action.
